biggest_catch: The referrer's $50 is credited within 7 business days of the new member's account opening — but the new member must be new to Four Points (no account relationship in the past 12 months).
catches: New member must be new to Four Points without a previous account relationship in the past twelve months.
Cap: limited to 10 referral credits per calendar year ($500).
Credits may be reported on 1099-MISC when required.
Early account closure may result in account fees.

c1.evidence: Verifiable program on institution's official domain: Four Points Federal Credit Union's official referral page (fourpointsfcu.org/referral-bonus/) pays current members $50 per qualifying referral.

c2.evidence: Concrete per-referral payout: the current (referring) member receives a $50 bonus for each new member referred, limited to 10 referral credits per calendar year ($500).

c3.evidence: Mechanism: the new member checks the 'referred by family, friend, or co-worker' box during the online application and enters the referring member's first and last name.

c4.evidence: Timing: the $50 credit for the referring member is made within 7 business days of the new member's account opening.

eligibility: Current Four Points Federal Credit Union members referring new members (new to Four Points, no account relationship in the past 12 months).
notes: Four Points FCU membership is open nationwide through the American Consumer Council. Distinct from any signup-bonus record (none found).
payout_quote: Current members will receive a $50 bonus. Any existing member can refer up to 10 new members a year. $50 credit for referring member will be made within 7 business days.

s1.note: No upfront fee charged to the referrer.

s2.note: Referral is free; no cost to refer.

s3.note: When required, credits will be reported on a 1099-MISC.

s4.note: Cap: limited to 10 referral credits per calendar year ($500).

s5.note: Program live on the current official page (observed 2026-09-23; page dated 2025-09-08).

s6.note: Referral mechanics stated on the official page: the new member checks the referral box during the online application and enters the referring member's name.

s7.note: Friend-side qualifying actions: open an account and be new to Four Points (no account relationship in the past 12 months).

steps: Give your friend your first and last name as the referring member.
Friend checks the 'referred by family, friend, or co-worker' box during the online application and enters your name.
Your $50 bonus credit is made within 7 business days of the friend's account opening, up to 10 per year.
timing: $50 credit for the referring member within 7 business days of the new member's account opening.
